# BostonHomeGuide.com

> BostonHomeGuide.com is the website of Will Shao, a REMAX Executive Realty agent serving Greater Boston and MetroWest Massachusetts. Will has nearly 20 years of experience and $120M+ in transactions, represents both buyers and sellers, and speaks English and conversational Mandarin.

The site covers buying and selling homes in Greater Boston, monthly market data from MLSPIN, guides to 71 towns and neighborhoods, and an evergreen blog for buyers and sellers.

## Main pages

- [Buyer's Guide](https://bostonhomeguide.com/buy): The home buying process in Massachusetts, from pre-approval to closing
- [Seller's Guide](https://bostonhomeguide.com/sell): Pricing, preparing, and marketing a home, plus a free home valuation request
- [Market Report](https://bostonhomeguide.com/market): Monthly median prices, days on market, and list-to-sale ratios by town
- [Neighborhoods](https://bostonhomeguide.com/neighborhoods): Guides to towns across Greater Boston and MetroWest
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://bostonhomeguide.com/mortgage): Estimate monthly payments
- [Blog](https://bostonhomeguide.com/blog): Articles for Greater Boston buyers and sellers
- [About Will Shao](https://bostonhomeguide.com/about): Background, experience, and client reviews
- [Contact](https://bostonhomeguide.com/contact): Send a message or call (781) 456-3541
